item.title: Traffic crash at base of Sagamore Bridge causing delays for motorists headed off-Cape; 2nd crash on Route 25 before Bourne Bridge.
item.description: BOURNE – A traffic crash was reported on Route 6 at the base of the Sagamore Bridge around 5:45 PM Wednesday. The collision was causing significant delays for commuters headed off-Cape. Mass State Police are investigating the cause of the crash. About 6:15 PM, another crash was reported on Route 25 before the Bourne Bridge. item.title: Firefighters extricate driver after two-vehicle collision in Provincetown
item.description: PROVINCETOWN – Firefighters had to extricate a driver after a two-vehicle collision in Provincetown. The crash happened about 6:15 PM Wednesday at Howland Street and Harry Kemp Way. Both drivers were evaluated for possible injuries. The crash is under investigation by Provincetown Police. Further details were not immediately available. item.title: Truck, SUV crash causes delays on Route 6 in Wellfleet
item.description: WELLFLEET – A traffic collision between a garbage truck and a SUV caused delays for a time on Route 6 in Wellfleet. The crash happened about 11:45 AM Thursday by Aaron Rich Road.
